data.vehicle_damage_summary: The vehicle has sustained moderate collision damage to the front-left wheel and suspension area, resulting in the wheel being removed. There is visible paint scratching and scuffing on the left front fender, left front bumper cover, and the left front wheel arch molding. In addition, internal inspection reveals damage to the left front suspension strut assembly and steering tie rod, both of which are marked with pink repairer notations indicating they require replacement.
